summary: Gauzy Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a September 15, 2026 Nasdaq delisting determination and its intent to appeal. Nasdaq flagged failure to regain the $1 minimum bid price under Rule 5450(a)(1) after the 180-day grace period expired September 14, 2026, compounded by delinquent filing of its FY2025 Form 20-F under Rule 5250(c)(1), which voided its compliance plan. An appeal request by September 22, 2026 stays suspension, keeping shares listed and tradeable; no board recommendation or advisor named. The risk-arb angle turns on Panel relief and remediation of the 20-F delinquency.
